narrative: Material PL1__M6707BBC exhibits erratic demand (CV=0.53) with a gamma-like distribution combined with unstable lead times (CV=0.50), creating compounded uncertainty during the replenishment cycle. The current SAP safety stock of 1,033 units provides less than 10% of the statistically required buffer for a 95% service level, creating significant stockout risk. The optimized (r,Q) policy raises safety stock to 10,259 units, sets a reorder point of 20,438 units, and uses an EOQ-derived order batch of 16,143 units, all within the 69,325-unit storage capacity. This delivers a 43% annual cost reduction while dramatically improving service reliability.
